case_31.reason: EVEN_SEQ_KBLOCK is computed from the total packed K length ((cu_k_seqlens[-1]-cu_k_seqlens[0]) % k_block_size == 0) instead of per-sequence lengths (as is correctly done for EVEN_SEQ_QBLOCK). When individual sequence lengths are not multiples of k_block_size but the total is (e.g. lens 3 and 5 with block size 4), the kernel skips both the load mask and the -inf tail mask, so keys belonging to the next sequence leak into the softmax, violating the contract.
